name: PBBANK
recent: Public Bank 在 2026 年 11 月 6 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，营收环比下降 1.3%，净利环比下降 2.8%。随后多家媒体报道其下调指引并提及赚幅压力，股价在 11 月 10 日下跌 3.47%。同期，EPF 与 KWAP 等主要股东持续有持股变动申报。
notable: 发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，营收环比下降 1.3%，净利环比下降 2.8%。
媒体报道公司下调指引并提及赚幅压力，股价在 11 月 10 日下跌 3.47%。
EPF 与 KWAP 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
risks: 媒体报道公司下调指引并提及赚幅压力。
季度净利同比减少 3.8%，环比减少 2.8%。

recent_en: Public Bank released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 6 November 2026, with revenue down 1.3% QoQ and net income down 2.8% QoQ. Media subsequently reported that the bank cut its guidance and flagged margin pressures, with shares falling 3.47% on 10 November. Meanwhile, substantial shareholders EPF and KWAP continued to file changes in their holdings.
notable_en: Released quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue down 1.3% QoQ and net income down 2.8% QoQ.
Media reported that the company cut its guidance and flagged margin pressures; shares fell 3.47% on 10 November.
EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in their shareholdings between October and November.
risks_en: Media reported that the company cut its guidance and flagged margin pressures.
Quarterly net income fell 3.8% YoY and 2.8% QoQ.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was MYR 3,773,791,000, down 1.3% QoQ and up 1.3% YoY; net income was MYR 1,773,129,000, down 2.8% QoQ and down 3.8% YoY; net margin was 47.0% versus 47.7% in the previous quarter.
